source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.en: My grandfather was a farmer his whole life.

sentences.ar: الأرض كانت كل حياته، وهو ما بيعرف غيرها.
sentences.en: The land was his whole life, and he knew nothing else.

sentences.ar: لما كبر بالعمر، صار الشغل صعب عليه.
sentences.en: When he grew old, the work became hard for him.

sentences.ar: بس كل موسم، كان يصر يحصد بإيده.
sentences.en: But every season, he insisted on harvesting with his own hands.

sentences.ar: سنة، حسينا إنه هاي رح تكون آخر حصاد إله.
sentences.en: One year, we felt this would be his last harvest.
The whole family came to help him with the harvest.

sentences.ar: جدي وقف بوسط الحقل، وعيونه مليانة دموع.
sentences.en: My grandfather stood in the middle of the field, his eyes full of tears.
He said: I built up this land with the sweat of my brow.

sentences.ar: قال: خذوا منها العبرة، الأرض ما بتخون.
sentences.en: He said: take a lesson from it, the land never betrays.
We harvested together from morning to evening.

sentences.ar: جدي كان يعلم الأحفاد كيف يمسكوا المنجل.
sentences.en: My grandfather taught the grandchildren how to hold the sickle.

sentences.ar: آخر النهار، جلسنا كلنا نأكل تحت الشجرة.
sentences.en: At the end of the day, we all sat eating under the tree.

sentences.ar: جدي نظر للحقل المحصود وابتسم بارتياح.
sentences.en: My grandfather looked at the harvested field and smiled with contentment.

sentences.ar: بعد هديك السنة، توفى جدي بهدوء.
sentences.en: After that year, my grandfather passed away peacefully.

sentences.ar: بس كل موسم حصاد، بنحس إنه معنا بالحقل.
sentences.en: But every harvest season, we feel he is with us in the field.
